rationale: compound_name is the only column with an explicit vehicle label; value set is 21 BRD-* compounds plus DMSO.
An anchored ^DMSO$ regex avoids partial matches against the BRD-* identifiers.
DMSO cells are present on all four hashed plates (Day 1: 3870, Day 2: 2466, Day 5: 3220, Day 7: 2249), so the vehicle trajectory covers every post-baseline timepoint.
Compound-treated wells are excluded from the primary trajectory and reserved as an independent perturbation stress test.

timepoint_derivation.reason: TIMEPOINT_HOURS mislabels all Day 7 cells as 24.0 h; PLATE_NAME/sample_name carry the correct Day 1/2/5/7 labels.
timepoint_derivation.resolution: days derived from plate/sample labels; recorded column kept for audit only
